basic_info.description: An exceptionally large duplex comprised of 3 bedrooms / 1 bathroom in the upper unit and 3 bedrooms / 1 bathroom on the lower unit. Situated in Noe Valley, just 3 short blocks from the 24th Street commercial corridor; this property is in a coveted and highly sought after location. Accessible from the bedrooms is a large, two level deck with views to the south and east. There are fabulous period details, gorgeous hardwood floors, gum wood trim and built-ins original to its 1924 construction. The building needs updating, but to some it could be considered partner perfect and a blank canvas to TIC groups and investors alike who wish to update the property to suit. The garage is massive offering 4+ car parking and development potential. Sitting on a large, flat 3998 square foot lot, the potential for this building is seemingly endless. This project is very exciting to the right buyer(s) of this rare vacant duplex in prime Noe Valley. Manageable updating, or a full renovation-expansion; it will appeal to a broad audience and is a must-see.
